Recordent Launches Credit Registry for Microfinance Institutions

Fintech firm Recordent has launched a credit registry specifically designed for non-profit Microfinance Institutions (MFIs). The initiative aims to help curb defaults within the MFI sector. Recordent has expressed optimism regarding the potential impact of this new credit registry.
